THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES RULES, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN
CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES RULES, 1958
No. W/34-1/58, 22nd November,
1958, (Gazette of West Pakistan, 12th December; 1958).-- In exercise of the
powers conferred by Section 15 West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958,
the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make the following rules for
carrying info effect be said Act:-
1. Short title.-- These
rules may be called the West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Rules, 1958.
2. Definitions.-- In these
rules unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say:‑
(a) "Act"
means the West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958;
(b) "District
Health Officer" means the Chief Medical Officer of the district in which
the orphanage is situated;
(c) "Form"
means a form annexed to these rates.
3. Form of application for
licence.-- Every application for a licence for establishing of continuing
an orphanage shall be in Form I and shall be accompanied by:
(1) A certificate
of the District Health Officer to the effect that satisfactory arrangement
exist for medical examination and treatment of the orphans proposed to be kept
in the orphanage; and
(ii) a
certificate of the Executive Officer, Public Works Department of the district,
where the orphanage is to be established or contained to the effect that the
building is suitable for the accommodation, vocational training and recreation
of the maximum number of orphans proposed to be kept in the orphanage.
4. Form of licence.-- Every
licence Issued under Section 4 of the Act shall be in Form II.
5. Disqualifications of
licences, etc.-- No person shall be a licencee or Manager, or be concerned
in any way with the management of an orphanage, who:
(a) has been
convicted of a non-bailable offence; or
(b) has been
convicted of any bailable offence, or is subject to an order of a Criminal
Court, which conviction or order, in the opinion of the District Magistrate,
implies a defect of character; or
(c) is an
undischarged insolvent or;
(d) is a
dismissed Government Servant or has been disqualified for appointment in
Government Service; or
(e) is in the
opinion of the District Magistrate for a defect of character or any other good
and sufficient reason not suitable or competent to discharge the
responsibilities with regard to the orphanage.
6. Conditions of licence.--
A licence granted under Section 4 of the Act shall be subject to the following
conditions:‑
(a) the licencee
shall make arrangements to the satisfaction of the District Magistrate for:-
(i) the
accommodations of the orphans;
(ii) the food
and clothing of the orphans;
(iii) the
medical attendance of the orphans;
(iv) the
education vocational training and recreation of the orphans;
(v) the
financing of the orphanage;
(vi) the
efficient running of the orphanage; and
(vii) the
auditing of the accounts of the orphanage:
(b) the licensee
shall present an annual report on the working of the orphanage to the District
Magistrate or any Magistrate nominated by him on such date as may be specified
by the District Magistrate;
(c) be licensee
shall assists in the inspection of the orphanage by such officer or officers as
may be authorised in this behalf by the District Magistrate;
(d) the licensee
shall not frame any regulation for the management of the orphanage without the
previous approval, of the District Magistrate;
(e) the licensee
shall comply with all instructions and directions which the District Magistrate
may issue from time to time.
7. Reports about admission and
discharge.-- Reports containing particulars of admission into and discharge
from the orphanage shall be made to the District Magistrate within seven days
in Form III.
8. Verification of report.--
All reports under Section 8 of the Act shall be verified by an officer
appointed by the District Magistrate for the purpose.
